name: DndList
description: A drag and drop reorderable list component. Renders draggable list items with grab handles and optional remove buttons. Uses native HTML drag and drop API.

notes: Each item has a grab handle that is keyboard-focusable.
Space/Enter on the grab handle starts a drag operation; arrow keys reorder during drag.
Delete key on an item triggers removal when removable is true.
aria-grabbed and aria-dropeffect communicate drag state to assistive technology.
Focus indicator uses a 2px solid outline with var(--color-border-focus).

items.description: Array of items to render. Each item has an id (string) and label (ReactNode).

onChange.description: Callback fired when items are reordered or removed.

removable.description: When true, each item shows a remove button.

className.description: Additional CSS class names applied to the root wrapper element.

do: Always provide an aria-label on the DndList describing the list purpose.
Keep items concise — long labels may truncate in narrow containers.
Use the onChange callback to persist the new order to your state/store.
dont: Do not nest DndList components — nested drag and drop is not supported.
Do not use for static, non-reorderable lists — use the List component instead.
